narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.05 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.03156-0.03288 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.03311; the first objective pays 0.75R at 0.03129.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.03156-0.03288
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.03311 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.77 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 43/100 — trend broken, flow confirming, whales offering
